children: Ronin's first governance proposal process, RGP-1, begins in October. RON holders will vote on deploying treasury assets as liquidity for RON/WETH and RON/USDC pools on the Katana DEX. The proposal puts a treasury decision directly in the hands of token holders and establishes the first formal voting process for the network.

Voting power is tied directly to RON holdings, and the proposal itself concerns treasury-backed liquidity for the network's core trading pairs. That combination gives holders a concrete decision to weigh ahead of the vote. Because participation depends on holding RON, the process links governance influence to the token rather than to delegated or external structures.

title: Ronin: RGP-1 governance launch opens voting on treasury liquidity for Katana pools - Oct 2026
